title: Anti-arthritic and anti-inflammatory potential of newly synthesized 2,3-disubsituted thiazolidine-4-one derivatives in CFA-induced arthritis model by targeting TLR4/NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling.
authors: Khan, Muhammad Ibrar; Zafar, Sana; Abbas, Muzaffar; Khan, Ashraf Ullah; Shah, Kifayat Ullah; Khan, Salman
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型噻唑烷酮衍生物的抗关节炎作用，涉及TLR4/NF-kB等信号通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a long-term autoimmune disorder associated with severe inflammation and primarily causes joint destruction. The present study explored the anti-arthritic and anti-inflammatory potential of two newly synthesized 2,3-disubsituted thiazolidine-4-one derivatives in a Complete Freund's Adjuvant (CFA)-induced arthritis in BALB/c mice by targeting TLR4/NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathway. METHODS: Acute inflammatory arthritis was induced by administering CFA (1 mg/ml, 20 microL) via intraplantar route (i.pl.) into the right hind paw of BALB/c mice. Animals were treated intraperitoneally (i.p.) with (E)-3-benzyl-2-((Z)-(1-(4-bromophenyl)ethylidene)hydrazono)thiazolidin-4-one (BEHT) and (E)-2-((Z)-(1-(4-chlorophenyl)ethylidene)hydrazono)-3-(4-nitrobenzoyl)thiazolidin-4-one (CEHNT) (1, 5, or 10 mg/kg). The anti-arthritic potential of BEHT and CEHNT was evaluated through nociceptive tests, histopathology, antioxidant assays, and biomolecular parameters. RESULTS: BEHT and CEHNT markedly suppressed CFA-induced pain hypersensitivity and paw edema dose dependently. Histopathological investigation showed improvement by attenuating cellular infiltration, edema, and fibrosis following BEHT and CEHNT administration. Both compounds also decreased serum C-reactive protein (CRP) levels and restored antioxidant enzyme activities, while simultaneously reducing oxidative stress. Likewise, BEHT and CEHNT markedly downregulated toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), p38, and extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) while upregulating the inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa B (IkappaB-alpha) expression as well as suppressing the release of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta). Molecular docking further demonstrated strong binding affinities of both compounds against TLR4, NF-kappaB, IkappaB-alpha, COX-2, p38, and pERK protein targets. CONCLUSION: BEHT and CEHNT demonstrated promising anti-arthritic potential in the acute phase of CFA-induced arthritis via inhibition of oxido-inflammatory signaling by altering the TLR4, NF-kappaB, IkappaB-alpha, COX-2, p38, and pERK expression.
abstract_zh: 背景：类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种与严重炎症相关的长期自身免疫性疾病，主要导致关节破坏。本研究通过靶向TLR4/NF-kappaB和MAPK信号通路，探讨了两种新合成的2,3-二取代噻唑烷-4-酮衍生物在完全弗氏佐剂（CFA）诱导的BALB/c小鼠关节炎中的抗关节炎和抗炎潜力。方法：通过足底途径（i.pl.）将CFA（1 mg/ml，20微升）注射入BALB/c小鼠右后爪，诱导急性炎症性关节炎。动物经腹腔注射（i.p.）给予（E）-3-苄基-2-（（Z）-（1-（4-溴苯基）亚乙基）肼基）噻唑烷-4-酮（BEHT）和（E）-2-（（Z）-（1-（4-氯苯基）亚乙基）肼基）-3-（4-硝基苯甲酰基）噻唑烷-4-酮（CEHNT）（1、5或10 mg/kg）。通过痛觉测试、组织病理学、抗氧化测定和生物分子参数评估BEHT和CEHNT的抗关节炎潜力。结果：BEHT和CEHNT剂量依赖性地显著抑制CFA诱导的疼痛超敏和爪水肿。组织病理学检查显示，BEHT和CEHNT给药后通过减轻细胞浸润、水肿和纤维化而有所改善。两种化合物还降低了血清C反应蛋白（CRP）水平，恢复了抗氧化酶活性，同时减少了氧化应激。同样，BEHT和CEHNT显著下调toll样受体4（TLR4）、核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）、环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、p38和细胞外信号调节激酶（ERK），同时上调核因子kappa B抑制剂（IkappaB-alpha）表达，并抑制肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）的释放。分子对接进一步显示，两种化合物对TLR4、NF-kappaB、IkappaB-alpha、COX-2、p38和pERK蛋白靶点具有强结合亲和力。结论：BEHT和CEHNT在CFA诱导的关节炎急性期通过改变TLR4、NF-kappaB、IkappaB-alpha、COX-2、p38和pERK表达抑制氧化-炎症信号，显示出有前景的抗关节炎潜力。
